---
title: "Matrix correction benchmark"
output: html_document
---

The benchmark compared ten matrix states using three batch-removal metrics and
six measures of biological preservation. The overall score gives 40% weight to
batch correction and 60% to biological preservation. This analysis recomputes
the composite scores and method ranking from the supplied metric table.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo <- if (dir.exists("../scripts")) normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo)
source(file.path(repo, "scripts", "01_matrix_correction.R"))
```

```{r results}
read.delim("analysis/01_matrix_correction/correction_method_scores.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

The panel-ready figure is written to
`analysis/01_matrix_correction/correction_benchmark.pdf`.
